newsitem.title: CHINA: China gears up for 1.71 billion festival travellers.
newsitem.headline: China gears up for 1.71 billion festival travellers.

text.p: China's hard-pressed transport system is gearing up to cope with the 1.71 billion passengers expected to flood roads, railways and air routes over the traditional new year festival, state media said on Friday.

State economic planners and officials of the ministries of railways, transport, construction and propaganda had ordered preparations for the yearly return of urban dwellers and migrant labourers to their home villages, the People's Daily said.

The number of passengers over the traditional lunar New Year holiday season, which this year runs from from January 18 to March 8, was expected to rise 4.8 percent from last year to 1.71 billion, the newspaper said.
The estimate is for the number of trips to be taken during the holiday period and includes frequent short-distance travel around major cities. China has a population of 1.2 billion.

The number of travellers by road would rise 5.5 percent compared with last year and air passengers would soar 15 percent. But rail passengers would fall 1.5 percent, it said without giving detailed figures.
China has said it will add more than 4,000 train carriages, 35,000 buses and 180 boats to existing services. Chinese lunar New Year falls on February 7.
